pipeline.name: Webhook Event Pipeline
pipeline.description: Processes inbound webhook events through validation, enrichment, type-based branching, storage, and notification steps.

steps.name: Receive Webhook Event
steps.description: Entry point for inbound webhook payloads. Extracts the raw event body and metadata from the HTTP request.

steps.name: Validate Payload Schema
steps.description: Validates the incoming payload against expected field requirements for each event type. Rejects malformed events before further processing.
steps.expression: (() => { const e = event; const required = ['event_id', 'event_type', 'timestamp', 'data']; const missing = required.filter(f => !e[f]); if (missing.length > 0) throw new Error('Missing required fields: ' + missing.join(', ')); return { ...e, validated: true }; })()

steps.name: Enrich Event Data
steps.description: Adds platform metadata to the event: processing timestamps, source identification, correlation IDs, and normalized field names.
steps.expression: (() => { const e = event; return { ...e, enriched: { processedAt: new Date().toISOString(), source: 'webhook-receiver', correlationId: e.event_id + '-' + Date.now(), normalizedType: e.event_type.replace('.', '_').toUpperCase() } }; })()

steps.name: Branch by Event Type
steps.description: Routes events to type-specific processing logic based on the event_type field. Orders, payments, and alerts get priority handling; other types follow the default path.

steps.name: Process Order Event
steps.expression: (() => { const d = event.data; return { ...event, processed: { entityType: 'Order', entityId: d.order_id, customerEmail: d.customer_email, totalAmount: d.total, currency: d.currency } }; })()

steps.name: Process Payment Event
steps.expression: (() => { const d = event.data; return { ...event, processed: { entityType: 'Payment', entityId: d.payment_id, orderId: d.order_id, amount: d.amount, method: d.payment_method, status: d.status } }; })()

steps.name: Process User Signup Event
steps.expression: (() => { const d = event.data; return { ...event, processed: { entityType: 'User', entityId: d.user_id, email: d.email, plan: d.plan || 'free', signupSource: d.source || 'direct' } }; })()

steps.name: Process Inventory Update Event
steps.expression: (() => { const d = event.data; return { ...event, processed: { entityType: 'InventoryItem', entityId: d.sku, warehouseId: d.warehouse_id, quantityChange: d.quantity_change, newQuantity: d.new_quantity } }; })()

steps.name: Process Alert Event
steps.expression: (() => { const d = event.data; return { ...event, processed: { entityType: 'Alert', entityId: d.alert_id, severity: d.severity, service: d.service, message: d.message, metricValue: d.metric_value } }; })()

steps.name: Store Processed Event
steps.description: Writes the validated, enriched, and processed event to the platform entity store using upsert semantics.

steps.name: Send Notification
steps.description: Emits a platform event so downstream subscribers (dashboards, alerting, integrations) are notified that a webhook event has been fully processed.
steps.expression: (() => { return { notified: true, eventType: event.event_type, entityType: event.processed?.entityType || 'Unknown', entityId: event.processed?.entityId || event.event_id, processedAt: event.enriched?.processedAt }; })()
